fixed.finding: src/App.tsx:240 — a delete on a running shield can skip the current-chat check because it trusts the cached currentChats.
fixed.what_changed: startChatAction now deletes directly only when the shield is not running. Every delete on a running shield goes to AgentsTab.doChatAction. That function reads pi's get_state at action time, sends new_session if pi holds the chat, and then deletes the chat. I removed the currentChats cache from App.tsx because nothing else used it. onChat now only updates the chat view.

message: I accept the finding. Every chat delete on a running shield now goes through AgentsTab, which reads pi's state when the action runs. A shield that is not running deletes directly, because no pi holds a chat. I removed the currentChats cache, so there is no stale path left. I changed only src/App.tsx, so I ran only pnpm build, and it passes.
